BSL Classics

35 VST3 analog-hardware plugins by Bankz Sound Lab. Shipped with Ovrtone; each is a circuit-informed model of a classic studio unit (names, looks and wording are ours). The modern plugin family, Undrtone, is a separate set and sits beside this one.

About these plugins

These are plain VST3 effects: drop one on a track in Ovrtone (or any other DAW) through the Audio FX slot. Every plugin keeps the hardware's own controls (names, ranges and stepped positions), plus host-level extras: Bypass, Oversampling, Theme and Undo. Reverbs and echoes also add a Duck knob, so the wet signal dips under the dry and swells back in the gaps.

Default oversampling: 2x on dynamics, EQs, preamps, consoles and tape; 4x on the hardest saturators (SAT-D, SAT-HG); 1x on reverbs and modulation. Raise it when you want the cleanest result; leave it as shipped for the best CPU trade.

Dynamics

BSL FET-1

1176-style FET feedback limiter

A fast FET peak limiter. Pushes transients down, adds a confident FET edge on the way.

Use for: vocals (ratio 4, attack 4-5, release 4), snare (ratio 20, fast attack), the parallel compression bus (all-buttons on).

BSL OPTO-2

LA-2A-style electro-optical leveler

Program-dependent optical compression. Smooth, slow, forgiving.

Use for: lead vocals, bass guitar, a stereo bus that wants gentle levelling. Set Peak Reduction by ear until the needle shows 4-6 dB of gain reduction, then lift Gain to match.

BSL VARI-6

Two-channel variable-mu limiter

A tube bus compressor with slow, musical release. Glues a mix.

Use for: the master bus, drum bus, a pop vocal group. 1-2 dB of gain reduction on the loudest hits is plenty.

BSL BUS-G

Console VCA bus compressor

The classic console-centre bus compressor. Tight, clean, the one everyone reaches for.

Use for: the stereo bus, drum bus. Ratio 2, attack 10 ms, release Auto, 2-4 dB gain reduction.

BSL VCA-25

VCA compressor with Thrust, New / Old

A fast, modern VCA with a high-pass sidechain (Thrust) that lets kicks breathe. New / Old switches response character.

Use for: drums, individual elements that need to sit back. Thrust on for mixes with a loud kick.

EQ and preamps

BSL TUBE-EQ

Passive program EQ + tube make-up

Pultec-style low boost, high boost / cut and the famous low-boost-and-cut-together trick for weight without mud.

Use for: kick (boost and cut at 100 Hz), bass, vocals (10 kHz boost 2-3), master bus.

BSL EQ-73

Class-A inductor EQ, console strip

A 1073-style strip: high-pass, low shelf, parametric mid, high shelf. The sound of British consoles.

Use for: vocals, electric guitar, snare. Add weight at 110 Hz, air at 12 kHz.

BSL EQ-PQ

Stepped proportional-Q EQ

Four stepped bands whose Q widens as gain shrinks. Musical cuts and boosts.

Use for: tone-shaping guitars, mastering moves, anything that wants its decisions on paper.

BSL EQ-CH

Console channel EQ, brown / black cards

A four-band console EQ with two cards: brown for broad shelves, black for surgical mids.

Use for: full channel-strip EQ work, mixing busy arrangements.

BSL EQ-AIR

Six-band parallel air EQ

Six fixed high shelves blended in parallel. Opens up dull sources without changing their body.

Use for: dull vocals, cymbal decay, acoustic guitar top-end sheen.

BSL PRE-N

Class-A transformer preamp

Preamp colour: iron, Class-A warmth, extra at louder input.

Use for: DI bass, boxy drum rooms, anything that wants to sound recorded instead of plugged in.

Consoles and summing

BSL DESK-S

Console channel strip

One channel of a British console: input, EQ-CH-style EQ, output. Signs the sound with every pass.

Use for: a strip on every track for a glued "in the desk" sound.

BSL DESK-V

Console channel / bus emulation

The classic LA console colour. Switches between channel-strip and bus modes.

Use for: the master bus (bus mode), individual channels (channel mode).

BSL DESK-500

500-series discrete strip

A boutique discrete 500-series channel: pre, EQ-PQ-style EQ, output.

Use for: hi-fi vocal chains, lead instruments, anything that wants a modern discrete sound.

BSL SUM-N

Non-linear summing, 32 channels

Models crosstalk, headroom and gentle saturation of a 32-input analog mixer. Lives on the stereo bus.

Use for: the master bus from the start of a mix; set input per group for the "sum" sound.

Tape

BSL TAPE-800

Multitrack tape machine

24-track-style tape: pre-emphasis, bias, head bump, wow and flutter.

Use for: drums, a full mix wanting glue and depth. Input + 3 to 6 dB saturates pleasantly.

BSL TAPE-102

Two-track mastering recorder

Half-inch mastering tape: wider, firmer low end, softer transient top.

Use for: the stereo bus at mix bounce. Keep input modest; the sound comes from the tape, not the drive.

BSL TAPE-37

Valve four-track recorder

Tape plus tube: dark, round, forgiving.

Use for: lo-fi beats, warming thin samples, taking the edge off harsh digital.

BSL TAPE-350

Tube recorder with slap

Classic tube tape with a built-in tape slap (short delay) echo send.

Use for: vocals, snare, guitars that want a vintage slap without routing a send.

BSL TAPE-DUO

16-track / 2-track machines

Two tape machines in one: 16-track multitrack and 2-track master. Switch per the stage of the mix.

Use for: stems on the multitrack, master on the 2-track bus.

Reverbs

BSL PLATE-1

Steel plate

The classic plate: bright, dense, a long tail that sits behind the voice.

Use for: lead vocals, snare, strings. Short decay (1.2 s) with ducking on vocals.

BSL DIGI-250

Early digital reverb, 6 programs

Classic 80s digital reverb: Room, Hall, Plate, Chamber, Large Hall, Reverse. The sound of the decade.

Use for: character verb on drums, synths, anything wanting an "80s record" sound.

BSL HALL-224

Digital hall / plate, 20k / 34k

Two sample rates (20 kHz and 34 kHz) model two eras of the same hall reverb.

Use for: hi-fi hall on vocals, strings, pianos. 34k for modern, 20k for the vintage grain.

BSL SPRING-2

Two-tank studio spring

A real-sounding spring tank: twang, boing, the lot.

Use for: dub, guitar, drums for grit. Ducking keeps it out of the vocal.

BSL SPRING-TANK

Tube-driven spring tank

Spring driven by a tube drive: thick, saturated spring sound.

Use for: guitar amp emulation, lo-fi drum ambience.

Echoes and modulation

BSL ECHO-201

Multi-head tape echo + spring

The Space Echo: three playback heads for rhythmic delays, with a built-in spring reverb.

Use for: dub vocals, guitars, hooks. Heads 1+2 for dotted eighths, 3 for longer trails.

BSL ECHO-3

Sliding-head tape echo

A sliding-head tape delay, controls that let you ride delay time as an instrument.

Use for: tape slap, pitch-shifting self-oscillation, feedback leads.

BSL CHORUS-1

BBD chorus / vibrato

Bucket-brigade chorus: lush, wide, with a true vibrato mode.

Use for: clean guitars (chorus), synths (vibrato), vocals for width.

BSL DIM-D

Dual BBD dimension, 4 buttons

Four fixed widths of stereo dimension chorus. Pick a button, it does the rest.

Use for: instant width on keys, guitars, backing vocals.

BSL FLANGE-126

BBD flanger / doubler

Studio flanger with a doubler mode: short, modulated delay for jet flanging or thickening.

Use for: flanged guitars, doubled vocals, flanged drum busses on breakdowns.

Saturators

BSL SAT-D

Five-style saturator

Five flavours of drive in one: tube, tape, transformer, transistor, digital. Each with a different character.

Use for: picking the right flavour per source. Tube for warmth, tape for glue, transistor for edge.

BSL SAT-HG

Pentode / triode + parallel saturator

Two valve modes plus a dry/wet parallel knob. Harder drive than SAT-D.

Use for: bass, kick, guitar amp sim. Parallel at 50-70% keeps the body.

BSL SAT-ONE

One-knob saturator

One knob, one job. Zero to all.

Use for: a quick colour pass on any track, mix-bus salt.

BSL SAT-DESK

Valve / transistor desk saturation

Models the saturation of a console channel driven hard: valve mode for warmth, transistor mode for bite.

Use for: giving a clean recording the "through a desk" sound.

BSL SAT-TUBE

Dual-input tube mixer

Two inputs sum through a tube stage. Mix matrix for width, drive for colour.

Use for: blending two takes, left/right amps, dry+wet parallel in one plugin.

BSL Classics is a circuit-informed set of analog-hardware plugins by Bankz Sound Lab. Model names and visuals are ours. Hardware names appearing in this document name the kind of unit that inspired each model, not products from other manufacturers. Every plugin has Bypass, Oversampling, Theme and Undo as host-level extras; reverbs and echoes have a Duck knob.

Ships with Ovrtone: the full installer puts each as a VST3 in C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3, where any DAW on the system picks it up.
